**Coaching note for the player:**

When your opponent's king is checked, look for double attacks. Your queen on f2 gives check *and* attacks White's queen on f7 at the same time—a royal fork. After White moves the king, your queen captures the undefended queen, winning 9 points of material. **Lesson:** After a forcing check, always scan what else your piece attacks before the opponent moves.
